reviews.comment: Ms. Victoria is AMAZING! She is so willing to help, kind, wise, intelligent, relatable, approachable and a saint! should be canonized bc of the patience she has to explain the information to us. She has super cool ways of relating bone landmarks and names to funny memorable things like "radius is rad" and many more. I loved her so much!! A SAINT!!!

Fantastic teacher who really cares about her students. She clearly loves what she teaches and presents information engagingly. Half of the class is lecture-based, the other is based on group discussions. Easy quizzes and assignments are graded highly if effort is seen. If you show up to class and do all the assignments, you should get an easy A.
The only note is that Victoria can go off-topic easily/ get off track when answering questions. Take that as you will, great for thorough answers, bad for getting through necessary materials.

Only days that count attendance are Thursdays, and most Tuesdays you get extra credit because less than half the class attends. Each week has an annotated reading and assignment. I ended with a 103 because I went everyday, so at the end I could afford to miss. The best 8am to take. No exams! Great teacher and really cares just about you learning.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I LOVED THIS PROF! I took her at 8 am and was worried it would be hard. I could not have been further from the truth. She has interesting lectures and frequently gives out extra credit. Each week, we had a challenge and annotated readings through perusall. No exams, and it's super easy to get a 100+ if you show up to class and do your work.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: BEST TEACHER EVER!! Izzo is so funny and kind and she really cares about her students. Only assignments is reading and challenge assignments, but super easy. Took her 8am and got extra credit just for showing up. If you do the work, it is an easy 100+ grade. No tests. You can reply to people on the reading, and class discussions were fun! TAKE HER!

Professor Izzo is clear and concise, her lectures involving class participation. No tests or exams, but weekly quizzes and challenge, along with a good amount of reading. Offers extra credit, and is very knowledgable and passionate about all things anthropology. She is inclusive and shares fun stories!

reviews.comment: Great professor who makes the class super easy. Weekly readings/assignments, in-class participations that require lots of participation, and some extra credit offered. No exams. She's nice and lenient (If you show you care and that you're actually trying in the class). Cancels class frequently--instead watch movies/documentary over the next lecture

reviews.comment: Victoria was the best Professor I have encountered at A&M. She always provided clear criteria of what was expected for tests and exams and hosted mayn review sessions to ensure that all students were readily prepared. She genuinely cared for her students and made an 8 am enjoyable. If you're taking any anthro class, I highly recommend her!
good sense of humor, friendly, kind
